title: Polysyllabic
summary: POLYSYLLAB'IC POLYSYLLAB'ICAL, adjective [from polysyllable.] Pertaining to a polysyllable; consisting of many syllables, or of more than three.

inlines.v: POLYSYLLAB'IC POLYSYLLAB'ICAL, adjective [from polysyllable.] Pertaining to a polysyllable; consisting of many syllables, or of more than three.
